notes_for_editor: Thin record. Only the association list and the Weebly Virginia list name this tower, and neither gives detail beyond name, county, coordinates and status. Two web searches found nothing on a tower at Vicksville. Do not confuse with the Capron tower moved to the Southampton Ag & Forestry Center, which the same list shows standing at 36.71223, -77.05640 (see us-va-capron-at-southampton-ag-forestry-center). The story is under the 120-word target because the evidence does not support more; nothing was padded. The Weebly page itself does not name an author, so the earlier 'by Ron Kemnow' attribution was removed.
